description: Defines the QhullHyperplane class, representing a hyperplane in Qhull geometry computations, including its properties, constructors, and methods for geometric calculations and IO.

classes.name: QhullHyperplane
classes.description: Represents a hyperplane with normal vector, offset, and dimension, providing methods for geometric operations and IO.

methods.name: distance
methods.description: Calculates the distance from the hyperplane to a given QhullPoint.

methods.name: hyperplaneAngle
methods.description: Calculates the angle between this hyperplane and another.

methods.name: norm
methods.description: Returns the norm of the hyperplane's normal vector.
